avis.titre: Really good daily sunscreen, but not quite perfect for me!
avis.texte: I've been using the La Roche-Posay Anthelios UV Air SPF 50 for about three weeks now and overall I'm happy with it. The texture is genuinely fantastic — it feels like a lightweight serum, spreads effortlessly, and absorbs very quickly without any greasiness. No white cast on my medium Indian skin tone, which is a huge win, and it layers nicely under makeup with minimal pilling. The hydration from hyaluronic acid and niacinamide is noticeable; my skin feels softer and looks a bit more even after consistent use. It's also completely fragrance-free, which I appreciate since I have sensitive skin. That said, I'm docking one star because it's not 100% matte on me. In the Georgia heat and humidity, I do get a slight sheen on my T-zone by mid-afternoon, so I still need to blot or touch up with powder. It's not heavy or oily, but it's not as "air-light" and completely matte as the marketing suggests for my combination skin. Protection seems solid, and I like knowing it has good antioxidant benefits. Overall, it's one of the better daily sunscreens I've tried, especially for the weightless feel and how well it blends. Would I repurchase? Probably yes, especially for days when I want something light and invisible. Just not my absolute favorite for very humid weather. Recommended with the small caveat about shine in heat/humidity.
